taste:
Garlic Pizza Bread has a pronounced garlic flavour, with herb butter spread generously over a thin pizza base. The oven baking gives the edges a crisp, golden finish, while the centre stays slightly soft and buttery. Rather than a uniformly crunchy slice, expect a contrast between the firmer crust and the middle, where the bread absorbs the savoury garlic flavour.

It is served hot, which makes the buttery centre an important part of its appeal. The aromatic topping puts garlic at the forefront, so this suits someone who wants a strongly flavoured side rather than plain bread. Alongside pasta or a fresh salad, it adds crunch and a buttery element.
